g.text: Temperature as character, and mediation in the middle: warm paper, funfun
silver for a proposal, dudu blue-green for what is stood behind, pupa
brick where reality disagreed, and violet for the hand — placed outside
the three families so authorship never becomes a truth-value. The mapping
↑↓ choose a setting, ←→ change it. Changes apply and are kept at once.
Enter on You changes your name and consultant. Enter on Budget changes it.
